apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.39.8 - PAST CHECK-INS, BIRTHDAYS BY MONTH, TARRY NIGHT, OFFICERS APPROVE PROFILE UPDATES (and Website Update 97, rules 51)
  - Attendance → Check In has a Date (today at first): an earlier date checks in someone who was forgotten, with the time
    they came (it starts on the earliest check-in of that day). The list on the right shows that date; Delete Selected
    removes a check-in. The portal and Beacon Admin get it at the next sync.
  - Dashboard → Birthdays: ‹ › show the month before or after (This month brings it back).
  - Meetings… → Setup → a meeting can be Tarry Night: one prayer group per hour (11 PM – 6 AM, the pastor at 4 AM). The
    groups are made in the portal (group 1 ticked by hand); here they show by hour, late arrivals go to an hour, and the
    picture says PRAYER CHAIN. The setup tells the phones who the pastor is.
  - The pastor (Lead pastor) gets "pastor" in his portal: he may delete a meeting and change or remove any announcement for
    everyone; this program makes his change permanent at the next sync.
  - The officers who see the Members directory get Profile updates to check in their portal (and a phone notification): their
    approval or rejection is done here at the next sync, as if decided in Profile Updates.
  - Times from the portal (Posted, Sent, Created) are shown on this computer's clock (they were 8 hours early).
  - This program's copy of the portal page and the rules: Website Update 97 (rules version 51).

apps.name: Beacon Admin
apps.whats_new: NEW IN 1.27.0: HOUSE VENUES TAKEN IN TURN - Activity Types & Roles → House venues: list the houses where the weekly Bible study is held. A new Bible study (New activity, Plan weekly activities, Copy to another date, or from the phone) gets the house whose turn it is: the one that hosted least recently, in the order of the list. If that house can't host that week, choose another in Venue; the skipped house stays first in line for the next week.
